definitions.explanation: To significantly modify or rebuild a building's structure, often involving major changes to the layout or basic framework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古民家|こみんか}→古民家：11833_kominka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改築|かいちく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We renovated an old traditional house and turned it into a café.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{改築|かいちく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The station renovation work is progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改築|かいちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{建|た}て{替|か}える→建て替える：10541_tatekaeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm deciding whether to renovate or completely rebuild the house.

notes:
USAGE: {改築|かいちく} refers to significant structural changes to a building. It differs from ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧ (interior renovation) and ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧ (repairs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改築|かいちく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (renovation work)
- {改築|かいちく}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (renovation costs)
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{改築|かいちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to renovate a house)

DISTINCTION FROM SIMILAR TERMS:
- ⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧ - new construction (building from scratch)
- {改築|かいちく} - renovation with major structural changes
- ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧ - interior renovation, remodeling
- ⟦{増築|ぞうちく}→増築：06568_zouchiku⟧ - building an addition/extension
- ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧ - repairs, fixing damage
- ⟦{建|た}て{替|か}え→建て替え：19739_tatekae⟧ - complete rebuild (tear down and build new)
